text.description_html:
35" x 40" Satin Stainless Steel Kick Plate

Large size commercial door kick plate primarily used in restaurants, warehouses and stores, but are popular in homes as well. Made of .050" thick high quality solid stainless steel for longevity. Packaged with stainless steel mounting screws for easy installation.

Specifications of DJO-KP-35x40-630 Stainless Steel Kick Plate:

  • Plate Height: 35"
  • Plate Width: 40"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Packaged with Stainless Mounting Screws

*Sold Individually.


**Made to order custom size. NOT returnable
